{{Nihongo|'''Bloody Malth'''|ブラディマルス|'''Buradi Marusu'''|"Bloody Mars"}} is the leader of the Malice Four and one of the [[Jaquio]]'s loyal servants. His powers are immense, so much so that he managed to defeat [[Jô Hayabusa]] in a one on one fight.

==History==
An enigma to all who come into contact with him, his past is shrouded in mystery. It is believed that he descends from a cursed European clan of warriors whom every generation inherits two artefacts of evil; the "Iron Mask of Blood" and the "Shield of Death". As a child he studied the Oriental philosophies and the Japanese martial arts, including the ways of Ninjutsu, becoming a shinobi master of frightening power. With his cursed artefacts he gained the name Bloody Malth (an erroneous transliteration from the Japanese "Marusu", meaning Malus, the Latin term for evil), and his power gained the attention of a man named Guardia de Mieux, earning him a place as master of de Mieux's villainous elite of warriors; the Malice Four.

Under the commands of the Jaquio, Malth was sent to find and defeat Jô Hayabusa, head of the [[Hayabusa Ninja Clan]], a branch of the [[Dragon Lineage]]. The two battle on a moonlit night and Malth defeats Jô in one strike. Later, Jô's son, [[Ryu Hayabusa]] tracks him down to Jaquio's lair. He traps the Dragon Ninja at the Cliffs of Execution, where he reveals that he is the one who fought Ryu's father and clashes with the young Hayabusa. He falls to the Dragon Ninja, who accuses him of killing the elder Hayabusa. Malth says that while he may have done many misdeeds, he did not kill Jo Hayabusa. Ryu yells "Liar!", to which Malth calmly replies "No, it is not a lie, your father is alive", but warns that if Ryu continues, "it will be the last thing he will ever see", before dying. Later, when Ryu sees that his father has been brainwashed and transformed into "the Masked Devil", he says to himself "so this is my destiny. Malth was telling the truth."

===''Ninja Gaiden''===
Bloody Malth is the boss of Act 5, and has a very simple pattern of walking back and forth along the left/middle area. However, his one attack is to charge a powerful electricity orb and release it at incredible speeds. Not only is this orb fast but it is very accurate at homing onto Ryu. When Malth is closer to the middle, Ryu can use the right platform to jump over it. When Malth is further left, it can only be dodged with a frame-perfect jump off that platform.

Although Malth has a shield, it has no effect on his defense and he can still be defeated just like every other boss. All of Malth's attacks do 3 damage. Malth's biggest weakness is the [[Jump & Slash Technique]]. All Ryu has to do is spin slash directly at Malth and he will die instantly. The [[Shuriken]] is also viable, since it is cheap in nine and allows Ryu to rack up damage from a safe distance.
